rules.statement: Section 13 of the Civil Procedure Code cannot be used to introduce a new 'matter in dispute' involving an entirely new cause of action which is inconsistent with the original cause of action.
rules.supporting_quote: Section 13 of the Civil Procedure Code which authorises the court to permit a person to be substituted or added as plaintiff in specified circumstances cannot be employed to introduce a new 'matter in dispute' involving an entirely new cause of action which is inconsistent with the cause of action which was pleaded between the original plaintiff and the defendant.
